observations: body L1-L4: the h of «1ʰ» and «2ʰ» is a raised italic h; one hour of time is 15° of hour angle, as printed. A heavy bracket closes the addition begun on p. 285, L37; the dash before «Schiaparelli» measures 10.2 pt.
body L5-L8: «Oloug Beg» is letter-spaced. With 12° for the first magnitude and steps of 2°, the sixth has 12° + 5 · 2° = 22°, as printed.

body L9-L11: the head of the chapter is set in the larger type, as printed. The a of «a)» prints damaged, with a speck inside it; the dash after it measures 10.1 pt. A blot covers the e of «Ptolemaeum» (L11).

body L15, L20-L24, L31: «Ptolemaeo», «‘Alī Qūshǵī», «Delambre», «al–Battānī» and «al–Farghānī» (L24) and «Ptolemaeus» are letter-spaced, and so is the quotation's «Ptole-maeus» (L24-L25); «al–Battānī» (L1) and «al–Baṣrah» (L22) are not. The long dashes measure 5.4 pt (L1, L24) and 5.3 pt (L22, «al–Baṣrah» and «aṣ–ṣafā’»).
body L27: the dash before «Quod» measures 10.1 pt.

body L33-L35: «al–Farghānī» (L33, long dash 4.6 pt) and «Ibn Rosteh» are letter-spaced; the dashes of «81–82» and «18–20» measure 5.3 pt each. A speck stands on the baseline after «3818» (L35), like a full stop, though the sentence runs on. The year 301 of the Hiǵrah began on 6 August 913 by the astronomical epoch of the tabular calendar (7 August by the civil epoch). Nallino's addenda (Part I, p. LXXV-LXXVI) find Ibn Rosteh's numbers, given on p. 287, in Thābit ibn Qurrah's booklet on the exposition of the Almagest; see the record of p. 287.

notes_left L2-L5: «Ibn Yūnus», «Delambre», «Alhazen» and «Ibn al-Haytham» are letter-spaced; the dash before «Alhazen» measures 7.7 pt and the hyphen of «al-Haytham» 3.2 pt. The rule between the two columns of the notes prints only beside the first line.
notes_right L1-L6: «Dieterici» is letter-spaced; «27-28» has a hyphen (3.1 pt). With the mile of 1973 m, al-Farghānī's radius of the Earth of 3250 miles (body L34) is 6412 km.

review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
